content:
The new Apple TV 4K has been long-awaited, originally expected to launch last fall. But with Siri AI finally ready, all signs point to the new Apple TV 4K making its debut, quite possibly at the September 9 event. Here's what's been rumored so far.

#1: Siri Remote Update

While no details have leaked, Apple is reportedly preparing an updated Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K.

Code in one of the test builds of macOS 26.7 appears to confirm the existence of a next-generation Siri Remote. Before this leak, Mark Gurman had reported that an "improved Apple TV remote" could launch alongside the new hardware.

It doesn't look like there will be major changes, but hopefully at least a second-generation ultra-wideband chip will be added to support Precision Finding.

#2: Siri AI and More Apple Intelligence Features

Siri AI is expected to be the main marketing focus for the new Apple TV and other new home products.

Apple has yet to announce whether the new assistant will come to Apple TV 4K or HomePod. But there's growing evidence that tvOS 27 will include Siri AI, and it's very likely to only support the new hardware.

Other Apple Intelligence features will likely be added as well, such as a more powerful search experience.

#3: New Generation A-Series Chip

The current Apple TV uses the A15 Bionic chip that first debuted in 2021. The good news is that the new model is expected to bring significant performance improvements.

The new A-series chip will be more powerful and support various AI features.

Rumors point to it possibly being an A17 Pro or A18 chip. But most of those reports came out before the launch of Siri AI. It wouldn't be surprising at all if Apple instead equipped it with a more powerful A19 or A20 chip.

#4: N1 Wireless Chip

From Doug's top-voted comment

First, it could replace older HomePod devices to support Siri AI.

Second, a built-in microphone so users can issue Siri AI commands without holding the remote.

Finally, it needs to have the universal TV remote functionality it should have had from the start (but was blocked back then by partners like Netflix), so I can search for new shows across all services, including cable providers.

Netflix's catalog data is publicly available, so Siri AI can search across all the media content I have access to. Apple TV should be that universal set-top box.

In addition, AirPlay should support syncing across multiple HomePods for a true home theater setup. That means users can fine-tune Atmos sound themselves.

The N1 wireless chip first debuted in the iPhone 17 and is also reportedly coming to the new Apple TV 4K.

With the N1 chip, the Apple TV will support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as Thread networking.

By comparison, the existing Apple TV hardware is already four years old and only supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.

What features do you hope the new Apple TV 4K will have? Let us know in the comments.
